plainTranslation: The Moon person's needs and the Sun person's way of being can rub in a place both people feel quickly. One person's normal self-expression may land as emotional disruption to the other. This can work, but only when both people stop treating their own rhythm as the only reasonable one.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort press against your sense of self, confidence, and direction.
summaryDeep: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort press against your sense of self, confidence, and direction. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The problem is taking the mismatch personally. You can start thinking, "Why are they like this?" when really, the two of you may just have different settings.
advice: Don't let every small rub become a larger story about the relationship. Name the pattern, adjust, and stop expecting the other person to magically know what would make you feel better.
